claim: Ending one campaign turn from the J14 base save (Britain, 1805 Winter, Early January) takes 127 s of waiting until the next player turn (Late January 1805) in a headless launch through load_save.sh --end-turn (the diplomacy offer declined and an event message closed by campaign_modal_close.lua on the way); a launch plus load adds about 40 s. At about 2 min a turn, a third of the way to the campaign end (many dozens of turns) is hours of watcher time, far over J46's 90 minute generation limit, so campaign_mid and campaign_late are not generated by ending turns; they wait for two saves from a real playthrough
